name: Shandong Chunguang Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Chunguang Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sales of soft magnetic ferrite powder and electronic information technology. The company's products include manganese zinc ferrite powder, nickel zinc ferrite powder, and magnesium zinc ferrite powder; magnetic core components; transformers, inductance, and power factor correction electronic devices for home appliances, photovoltaics, energy storage, charging stations, medical equipment, and energy field, and wave filters; and wall mounted, desktop, and switching power supply adapters.
